description: bsaylor is a collection of Pure Data (Pd) external objects developed by Benjamin Saylor for audio processing and synthesis, featuring tools such as partconv~ for partitioned fast convolution, pvoc~ for phase vocoding, and svf~ for state variable filtering.

research.notes: Originally created by Benjamin Saylor and distributed via the Pure Data CVS/SVN externals repository and Pd-extended, bsaylor is maintained under the pd-externals organization on GitHub using pd-lib-builder, and is distributable via Pure Data's Deken package manager and Debian packages (pd-bsaylor).
